purpose: Isolated S34 review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields. Effect present/absent/not_assessed gates applicability with reviewed severity; BARS item responses are measurement context only pending the complete reviewed source; no diagnosis from unreviewed total and no treatment threshold.

fields.definition: Akathisia effect status for this follow-up encounter: present, absent or unresolved assessment requiring clinician review of subjective restlessness, observed motor restlessness, medication relationship, onset and alternative explanations with BARS measurement context when the complete reviewed source is available.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/akathisia-criteria.md — Diagnostic features (subjective plus observed restlessness; medication relationship within 4 weeks) and Clinical assessment and exclusions
fields.operationalization: Present requires clinician-recorded subjective restlessness plus observed motor restlessness with medication timeline and onset review plus alternative explanations considered; Absent requires assessment finding no such syndrome; Unresolved/not_assessed/unknown means assessment incomplete or conflicting and pauses. BARS item responses are measurement context only when the complete reviewed source is available; no diagnosis is inferred from an unreviewed BARS total and the global 2 or greater threshold is a review candidate only. Pseudoakathisia requires reassessment rather than assumption. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether akathisia is associated with antipsychotic exposure in this follow-up context, after alternative explanations are considered.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-13.md — Implementation (antipsychotic-induced akathisia; difficult to distinguish from psychomotor agitation)
fields.operationalization: Established requires documented antipsychotic exposure with onset within weeks of initiation or escalation (or after reduction of extrapyramidal medication) and alternative contributors reviewed; NotEstablished requires assessment finding no such association or an alternative explanation. Unknown pauses. Exposure agents and windows only; no dose/route/frequency. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether antipsychotic dose reduction is feasible in this follow-up context.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-13.md — Implementation (reduction if feasible; weigh against psychotic symptoms)
fields.operationalization: Yes means clinician records dose reduction as feasible with attribution; No means review found it not feasible or psychotic-worsening tradeoff precludes it. This is a feasibility assumption for review, never a dose order or regimen detail. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
